name: Hard Currency
note: R8.20, Module R2 SSD p.71. A light cruiser at 0.75 move cost, the only Orion so far to pay that rather than 0.67 or 1.0. THREE WARP ENGINES, and the third is the point: a CENTER WARP of just THREE boxes beside two tens, which is why its sheet carries a note no other Orion does - 'NOTE CENTER WARP ENGINE IS DAMAGED UNDER (G15.212)' - singling out which engine the doubling box loss comes from. ITS TRACKS ARE FIVE STEPS, not six: sensor 6/6/5/1/0, scanner 0/0/1/5/9, damage control 4/4/2/2/0. The sensor falls off a cliff, 5 to 1, where a six-step Orion steps 5/3/1. NO LABORATORIES, like the OK6 and unlike the AR beside it in the same book. Nine phasers, including a fifth Ph-1 on the centerline that the AR and BR do not carry. Its two centerline mounts are declared adjacent under the owner's silence rule (2026-10-20): a sheet states non-adjacency only when it is the exception, as the DBR's does, and this one says nothing. Not nimble by the same reading. NOT MODELLED: the Y170 plasma carronade and sabot refit (Module R10), the MINELAYER REFIT (R8.R1), and (R8.R3) for option mount firing arcs.
